func isHostnamePort(fl FieldLevel) bool {
	val := fl.Field().String()
	host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(val)

		return false
	}

	if portNum, err := strconv.ParseInt(port, 10, 32); err != nil || portNum > 65535 || portNum < 1 {
